name: Glassmorphism
oneLiner: Frosted panels floating over saturated color: blur, a 1px light edge, and enough backdrop drama to earn the transparency.
bestFor: marketing heroes with one big visual
apps with a colourful brand backdrop

effects.specular: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) on every glass panel

motion.reducedMotion: drop backdrop-filter animation; keep panels static and fully opaque

default.base: position: relative; padding: 24px; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(140%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(140%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55), 0 20px 48px -20px rgba(20, 26, 46, 0.28)

flat.base: padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

primary.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(91, 91, 214, 0.6)

glass.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

default.base: position: sticky; top: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; height: 56px; padding: 0 20px; margin: 16px auto; max-width: 1080px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(140%)
font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; color: var(--uiux-color-text)
default.label: margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

default.base: height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem; backdrop-filter: blur(10px)

do: Always pair transparency with a real colourful backdrop; glass on flat white is just grey.
Add a 1px translucent light border and an inset specular highlight so edges read as material.
Limit to two stacked layers of glass; three or more turns to mud.
Keep text on the more opaque panel and check contrast against the darkest backdrop area.
dont: Do not stack glass panels over each other unless the back panel is flat color.
Do not use blur above 24px; radii above that read as fog and cost performance.
Do not blur content the user needs to read behind the panel.
Do not forget the fallback: solid surface color when backdrop-filter is unsupported.
antiPatterns: Glass card on a white background with an 8% white fill and no border — invisible.
Five nested frosted layers in a modal-as-dashboard.
Backdrop-filter on 40 list rows, tanking scroll on mid-range phones.

notes: Translucency makes effective contrast depend on what scrolls behind; test the worst case and raise fill opacity until text passes 4.5:1.
Backdrop-filter can break text rendering in some browsers; provide `@supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(1px))` with an opaque fallback.
Blurred backgrounds are decoration; never blur content that conveys meaning.
